messages.html:
Frontend Weekly · Issue 312 · 8 October 2026

Good morning! This week: page transitions without a framework, container queries that earn their keep, and a diet plan for your images.

1. View Transitions between pages – a practical guide

Cross-document transitions now work in every major browser. Here is how to add them to a static site in twelve lines of CSS, and when not to.

2. Container queries in a real project

A product card that fits a sidebar, a grid and a carousel without a single media query.

3. Cut image weight on static sites by 60%

AVIF, sizes that match the layout, and the one attribute most sites forget.

Read the whole issue
